title: The Man Who Bought A Bank For $1
sources: Chicago Tribune, 'Stony Island Arts Bank' (Theaster Gates bought the abandoned 1923 bank for $1 from the city in 2012)
The Guardian, 'Theaster Gates: the artist who bought a Chicago bank for $1' (City faced $1M demolition cost)
Architectural Digest, 'How Theaster Gates Turned an Old Bank into an Art Mecca' (Funded renovation by selling marble bathroom slabs as bank bonds for $5,000 each at Art Basel)

lines.text: In twenty twelve, a man bought an entire bank

lines.text: Chicago was going to pay a million bucks

lines.text: so an artist named Theaster offered them a single dollar instead.
